name: Big Push
hint: A 4 on a block means four pushers. Line up!
why4: The block is marked 4 and fills the tunnel: it only moves with all four pushing in one line.
solution: Everyone walks right, hopping the 1-high and 2-high bumps; P1 touches the key on the 2-high bump at x=11 and carries it.
Everyone jumps the 2-wide pit at x=14-15.
Line up in the tunnel: P1 against the block (x=22), P2 behind P1, P3 behind P2, P4 behind P3; all hold Right.
Keep pushing until the block drops into the hole at x=28-30 (its top ends flush with the floor).
Walk over the block to the door at x=37; P1 touches it with the key; all four press Down.
